question: What are your working hours?
answer: Our customer support team is available from Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can contact customer support by emailing support@example.com or using the Contact Us page.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click the Forgot Password link on the login page. We will send password reset instructions to your registered email address.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up, enter your name, email address, and password, then verify your email to create an account.

question: How can I change my account details?
answer: Log in to your account, open Profile Settings, update your information, and click Save Changes.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, UPI, net banking, and selected digital wallets.

question: Is cash on delivery available?
answer: Cash on delivery is available for selected products and delivery locations.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the relevant order, and click Track Order to view its latest delivery status.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Yes, you can cancel an order from My Orders before it has been shipped.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: Open My Orders, select the delivered product, choose Return Item, and follow the instructions shown on screen.

question: When will I receive my refund?
answer: Refunds are usually processed within 5 to 7 business days after the returned item passes inspection.

question: How much is the delivery charge?
answer: Delivery charges depend on the product, delivery address, and selected shipping method. The final charge is shown during checkout.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery generally takes 3 to 7 business days, depending on your location.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: You can change the delivery address before your order is shipped by visiting My Orders and selecting Edit Address.

question: What should I do if my order is damaged?
answer: Please contact customer support within 48 hours of delivery and provide your order number along with photos of the damaged product.

question: What should I do if I received the wrong product?
answer: Contact customer support with your order number and product photos. We will arrange a replacement or refund.

question: Do you offer discounts?
answer: Yes, discounts and promotional offers are announced on our website and during checkout when applicable.

question: How can I apply a coupon code?
answer: Enter your coupon code in the Apply Coupon section during checkout, then click Apply.

question: Is my payment information secure?
answer: Yes, we use secure payment gateways and encryption to protect your payment information.

question: Can I save items for later?
answer: Yes, click the wishlist or save-for-later option on a product page to access the item later.
